The '''35th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2024 Producers Guild Awards''' or '''2024 PGA Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2023, were held at the Ray Dolby Ballroom at [[Ovation Hollywood]] in [[Los Angeles]], California on February 25, 2024.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chuba |first1=Kirsten |last2=Nordyke |first2=Kimberly |title=PGA Awards: ''Oppenheimer'' Takes Top Film Prize |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2024-producers-guild-awards-winners-list-1235833336/ |access-date=February 26, 2024 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=February 25, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release|title=The Producers Guild of America Awards ''Oppenheimer'', ''Succession'', ''BEEF'', ''The Bear'', ''American Symphony'' Top Honors at the 35th Annual Producers Guild Awards |url=https://producersguild.org/2024-pga-awards-winners/ |publisher=Producers Guild of America |access-date=February 26, 2024 |location=Los Angeles, CA |date=February 25, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Michael |title=Producers Guild Reveals Date, Submission Calendar for 2024 PGA Awards |url=https://variety.com/2023/film/awards/producers-guild-date-submission-calendar-2024-pga-awards-1235616512/ |access-date=December 8, 2023 |work=Variety |date=May 17, 2023}}</ref> The nominees in the documentary category were announced on December 12, 2023,<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=Producers Guild Awards Reveals Documentary Film Nominations |url=https://deadline.com/2023/12/producer-guild-awards-documentary-nominations-2024-1235664723/ |website=Deadline |access-date=December 16, 2023 |date=December 12, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |title=2024 Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced for Documentary Motion Pictures |url=https://producersguild.org/2024-pga-awards-documentary-motion-picture-nominees/ |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |access-date=December 16, 2023 |date=December 12, 2023 |location=Los Angeles}}</ref> the nominations in the sports, children's and short-form categories were announced on December 15, 2023,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Michael |title=''I Think You Should Leave with Tim Robinson'', ''Goosebumps'', ''Sesame Street'' Among PGA Noms for Short Form, Children's, Sports |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/awards/producers-guild-awards-2024-nominations-short-form-childrens-sports-1235841239/ |access-date=December 16, 2023 |work=Variety |date=December 15, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |title=2024 Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced for Sports, Children's and Short-Form Television Programs |url=https://producersguild.org/2024-pga-awards-sports-childrens-and-short-form-nominees/ |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |access-date=December 16, 2023 |date=December 15, 2023 |location=Los Angeles}}</ref> and the remaining nominations for film and television were announced on January 12, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Verhoeven |first=Beatrice |date=January 12, 2024 |title=''Oppenheimer'', ''The Crown'' Among 2024 Producers Guild Awards Nominees |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2024-producers-guild-awards-movie-tv-nominations-list-1235786564/ |access-date=January 12, 2024 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |url=https://producersguild.org/2024-pga-awards-motion-pictures-and-television-categories-nominees/ |title=2024 Producers Guild Award Nominees Announced for Motion Picture and Television Program Categories |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |date=January 12, 2024 |access-date=January 12, 2024 |location=Los Angeles}}</ref>  The nominations for the PGA Innovation Award were announced on February 9, 2024.<ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title= Nominees for the Producers Guild Innovation Award Announced|url=https://producersguild.org/2024-innovation-award/ |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Producers Guild of America]] |agency= |date=February 9, 2024 |access-date=February 12, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Coates |first1=Tyler |title=Producers Guild Reveals 2024 Innovation Award Nominees |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/producers-guild-innovation-awards-nominees-list-2024-1235820921/ |access-date=February 12, 2024 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=February 9, 2024}}</ref>

The winners of the sports and children's categories were revealed on February 20, 2024, in [[Manhattan]], while the winners of the PGA Innovation Award and short-film categories were announced on February 22, 2024, during the PGA nominees celebration in Los Angeles.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pedersen |first=Erik |date=February 22, 2024 |title=Producers Guild Reveals Early Winners Ahead Of Sunday's PGA Awards – Update |url=https://deadline.com/2024/02/producers-guild-awards-2024-winners-1235832329/ |access-date=February 24, 2024 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref>
